text:
Situation: VinCRIStine sulfate 1 mg/mL, 2 mL vials are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 64 vials (20.4 days at 3.1 vials/day). Corvale General holds 67 vials (23.3 days at 2.9 vials/day).

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 61703030925 identifies Hospira Australia Pty Ltd (FEI 3001174929) as the registered manufacturing plant. FDA inspected that plant on 2022-09-02 and classified the inspection VAI. An earlier inspection ending 2014-03-04 was classified OAI and a Warning Letter was issued on 2014-09-26.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks at both campuses. No national shortage is posted. The 2022 VAI classification indicates the plant was operating with acceptable compliance at that time.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer contacts the supplier to confirm current allocation status and lead times; Supply Chain Director approves any purchase commitments.
2. Buyer monitors FDA communications daily for any future shortage posting; Pharmacy Director approves escalation if a posting appears.
3. Inventory team verifies weekly physical counts at both campuses; Pharmacy Operations Manager approves redistribution if one site falls below 14 days on hand.

Not recommended: Initiating conservation protocols, therapeutic substitutions, or compounding alternatives at this time.
